label: Copying the 2nd/3rd token of a very short sequence (L=3; weakly L=4)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase of short sequences, at recall_idx 1 and 2 (the first two copy steps after the step right after <DEL>). For L=3 it fires on both copy steps with near-perfect precision (5209/5210), and these steps carry the strongest activations (74% of mass; the top examples are all L=3, e.g. u o h <DEL> [u] [o]). For L=4 it fires more weakly and selectively at recall_idx 1-2, mostly when the input token is one of o,i,a,g,2,0,u,w,n; that token dependence is approximate and accounts for most of the remaining errors. Essentially never fires during the original phase, on the delimiter step, at recall_idx 0, or for L>=5 (<0.5% of mass). Strength: L=3 >> L=4.
